plan.objective: Generate qualified printer rental inquiries from office teams in Pasig and nearby business districts.

audience.primary: Office admins and operations leads in SMEs and mid-market teams
audience.secondary: Procurement staff looking for flexible printer rental arrangements

plan.heroAngle: Help Pasig office teams avoid downtime with a rental setup that includes support and predictable response expectations.
contentPillars: Pasig office uptime and support response
Simple monthly cost positioning without overclaiming savings
Local-business relevance for admins and procurement teams

deliverables.purpose: Drive early traffic to the landing page and test hook strength
Package the offer into a visually direct format
Test concise hooks and conversation-starting copy
Support authority and reuse the campaign angle in video form

weeklySequence.action: Launch the hero post for Pasig with the strongest office-uptime hook.
Publish the static ad variant with a shorter CTA-driven caption.
Run a shorter hook that reframes printer rental as an operations decision.
Publish or prepare the video explainer version of the same offer.
Review early results and repost only with updated copy if the first hook underperforms.

approvalGates: Approve landing page destination before publishing.
Approve channel copy before any live posting.
Keep unsupported channels in planning mode until APIs are wired.

summary: The campaign planner turns the research into one focused weekly sequence around Pasig office uptime. The plan keeps one clear CTA, one landing page, and one hero angle so the later workers can generate assets and copy without drifting off-message.
